MATCH (pol:Policy)
WHERE toLower(apoc.text.clean(pol.holder)) CONTAINS toLower(apoc.text.clean('Ayça'))

WHERE n:Chunk OR n:Document

Yaptığım sorgular (STRING NORMALİZASYON kurallarına göre çalıştırıldı):

  AND coalesce(pol.year, '') = 2020
OPTIONAL MATCH (pol)-[r]-(n)
WHERE n:Chunk OR n:Document
RETURN pol, collect(DISTINCT n) AS relatedNodes
LIMIT 20

2)
MATCH (pol:Policy)
WHERE toLower(apoc.text.clean(pol.holder)) CONTAINS toLower(apoc.text.clean('Ayca'))
  AND toLower(apoc.text.clean(pol.policyName)) CONTAINS toLower(apoc.text.clean('d5'))
  AND toLower(apoc.text.clean(pol.policyName)) CONTAINS toLower(apoc.text.clean('konut'))
  AND coalesce(pol.year, '') = '2020'
OPTIONAL MATCH (pol)-[r]-(n)
WHERE n:Chunk OR n:Document OR n:Policy
RETURN pol, collect(DISTINCT n) AS relatedNodes
LIMIT 20

- İsim farklı yazılmış olabilir (örn. Ayca yerine A. Ayça, Ayça Soyadı vs.). İsim soyisim veya sadece soyadı ile arama yapayım.
- Poliçe adı farklı biçimde saklanmış olabilir (ör. "D-5 Konut", "d5-konut", "Konut D5"). Daha geniş/kısmi eşleşme veya regex arayayım.
- Yıl alanı farklı formatta olabilir (number vs string) veya yıl atanmamış olabilir. Yılı kaldırıp sadece isim + poliçe tipi ile arama yapabilirim.
- Poliçe başka bir yıl altında kayıtlı olabilir (ör. 2019 veya 2021). Yılı dışarı bırakarak arama yapabilirim.

Ne yapmak istersiniz?
- İsim alternatiflerini (soyadı veya farklı yazımlar) verir misiniz?
- Yılı kaldırarak veya poliçe adını daha geniş/kısmi eşleşmeyle aramamı ister misiniz?

Bulunan düğümlere ait Chunk, Document ve Policy bilgileri:
- Eşleşen kayıt bulunamadı; dolayısıyla ilgili Chunk/Document/Policy düğümleri yok (boş sonuç).

tools.name: search_memories
tools.description: Search and retrieve memories from the knowledge graph

query.description: Search text to find in any property (searches for ANY word - e.g. "Ben Weeks" finds memories containing "Ben" OR "Weeks")

depth.description: Relationship depth to include, defaults to 1

order_by.description: Sort order such as created_at DESC, name ASC

limit.description: Maximum results to return, defaults to 10, max 200

since_date.description: ISO date string to filter memories created after this date (e.g., "2024-01-01" or "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z")

tools.name: create_memory
tools.description: Create a new memory in the knowledge graph. Consider that the memory might already exist, so Search → Create → Connect (its important to try and connect memories)

label.description: Memory label in lowercase (use list_memory_labels first to check existing labels for consistency) - common: person, place, organization, project, event, topic, object, animal, plant, food, activity, media, skill, document, meeting, task, habit, health, vehicle, tool, idea, goal

properties.description: Information to store about this memory (use "name" as primary identifier, e.g. {name: "John Smith", age: 30, occupation: "Engineer"})

tools.name: create_connection
tools.description: Create a connection between two memories (its good to have connected memories)

type.description: Relationship type such as KNOWS, WORKS_ON, LIVES_IN, HAS_SKILL, PARTICIPATES_IN

tools.name: update_memory
tools.description: Update properties of an existing memory such as adding more detail or make a change when you find out something new

nodeId.description: ID of the memory to update

tools.name: update_connection
tools.description: Update properties of an existing connection between memories

type.description: Relationship type to identify which connection to update (e.g. WORKS_AT, KNOWS, MANAGES)

tools.name: delete_memory
tools.description: Delete a memory and all its connections (use with caution - this permanently removes the memory and all its connections)

nodeId.description: ID of the memory to delete

tools.name: delete_connection
tools.description: Delete a specific connection between two memories (use with caution - this permanently removes the relationship)

type.description: Exact relationship type to delete (e.g. WORKS_AT, KNOWS, MANAGES)

tools.description: List all unique memory labels currently in use with their counts (useful for getting an overview of the knowledge graph)

tools.name: get_guidance

tools.name: search_memories
tools.description: Search and retrieve memories from the knowledge graph

query.description: Search text to find in any property (searches for ANY word - e.g. "Ben Weeks" finds memories containing "Ben" OR "Weeks")

depth.description: Relationship depth to include, defaults to 1

order_by.description: Sort order such as created_at DESC, name ASC

limit.description: Maximum results to return, defaults to 10, max 200

since_date.description: ISO date string to filter memories created after this date (e.g., "2024-01-01" or "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z")

tools.name: create_memory
tools.description: Create a new memory in the knowledge graph. Consider that the memory might already exist, so Search → Create → Connect (its important to try and connect memories)

label.description: Memory label in lowercase (use list_memory_labels first to check existing labels for consistency) - common: person, place, organization, project, event, topic, object, animal, plant, food, activity, media, skill, document, meeting, task, habit, health, vehicle, tool, idea, goal

properties.description: Information to store about this memory (use "name" as primary identifier, e.g. {name: "John Smith", age: 30, occupation: "Engineer"})

tools.name: create_connection
tools.description: Create a connection between two memories (its good to have connected memories)

type.description: Relationship type such as KNOWS, WORKS_ON, LIVES_IN, HAS_SKILL, PARTICIPATES_IN

tools.name: update_memory
tools.description: Update properties of an existing memory such as adding more detail or make a change when you find out something new

nodeId.description: ID of the memory to update

tools.name: update_connection
tools.description: Update properties of an existing connection between memories

type.description: Relationship type to identify which connection to update (e.g. WORKS_AT, KNOWS, MANAGES)

tools.name: delete_memory
tools.description: Delete a memory and all its connections (use with caution - this permanently removes the memory and all its connections)

nodeId.description: ID of the memory to delete

tools.name: delete_connection
tools.description: Delete a specific connection between two memories (use with caution - this permanently removes the relationship)

type.description: Exact relationship type to delete (e.g. WORKS_AT, KNOWS, MANAGES)

tools.name: list_memory_labels
tools.description: List all unique memory labels currently in use with their counts (useful for getting an overview of the knowledge graph)

tools.name: get_guidance
tools.description: Get help on using the memory tools effectively

topic.description: Topic: connections, labels, relationships, best-practices, examples, or leave empty for all

Yangın, infilak, dahili su, duman ve GLK.HH.KN.-Terör risklerini kapsar. Kiracının mal sahibine, mal sahibinin kiracıya, mal sahibi veya kiracının komşularına karşı sorumluluğunda ödenecek tazminat, toplam sigorta bedelinin % 20'si ile sınırlıdır.

## Kira Kaybı

Dahili su, hava taşıtları ve kara taşıtları çarpması, duman, dolu, enkaz kaldırma masrafları.

## Sel / Su Baskını Teminatı:

-Her bir sel/su basması hasarında, azami 1,500 EUR olmak üzere bina ve eşya sigorta bedelleri üzerinden % 2 oranında bulunacak tenzili muafiyet bina ve eşya  için ayrı ayrı uygulanır.

## Enkaz Kaldırma Masrafları

Enkaz kaldırma masrafları teminatı sigorta bedelinin % 4'ü ile sınırlıdır.

Yangın ve Ek teminatlarına bağlı bir hasar sonucunda meydana gelebilecek enkazın kaldırılması (yıkım sökme, temizlik vb)masrafları poliçede belirtilen limit ile teminata dahil edilmiştir. Bir hasarda sigortacının ödeyeceği toplam tazminat tutarı Enkaz Kaldırma Masrafları da dahil olmak üzere her halükarda toplam Yangın Sigorta bedelini aşmayacaktır.

function.arguments:
{"query":"MATCH (c:Customer)-[:HAS_POLICY]->(p:Policy)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(pt:PolicyType)
WHERE toLower(apoc.text.clean(coalesce(c.name,c.fullName))) CONTAINS toLower(apoc.text.clean('Ayça'))
  AND (p.year = 2020 OR (p)-[:HAS_YEAR]->(:PolicyYear {year:2020}))
  AND (
        toLower(coalesce(p.type,'')) CONTAINS 'konut'
     OR toLower(coalesce(pt.name,'')) CONTAINS 'konut'
     OR toLower(coalesce(p.name,'')) CONTAINS 'konut'
  )
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:HAS_INSURED_ITEM]->(ii:InsuredItem)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[r]->(d:Document)
WHERE type(r) IN ['DOCUMENTED_IN','HAS_ENDORSEMENT','HAS_CANCELLATION']
RETURN c.name AS customerName, c.fullName AS customerFullName, p.id AS policyId,
       p.policyNumber AS policyNumber, p.name AS policyName, p.type AS policyTypeProperty,
       pt.name AS policyTypeNode, p.year AS year,
       collect(DISTINCT ii.name)[0..10] AS insuredItems,
       collect(DISTINCT {docFile:d.fileName, docType:d.docType, docYear:d.year, docLink:d.doc_link, relType:type(r), source:r.source, endorsement_type: r.endorsement_type})[0..20] AS documents
LIMIT 10"}

function.arguments:
{"query":"MATCH (c:Customer)-[:HAS_POLICY]->(p:Policy)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(pt:PolicyType)
WHERE toLower(apoc.text.clean(coalesce(c.name,c.fullName))) CONTAINS toLower(apoc.text.clean('Ayça'))
  AND (p.year = 2020 OR (p)-[:HAS_YEAR]->(:PolicyYear {year:2020}))
  AND (
        toLower(apoc.text.clean(coalesce(p.type,''))) CONTAINS toLower(apoc.text.clean('konut'))
     OR toLower(apoc.text.clean(coalesce(pt.name,''))) CONTAINS toLower(apoc.text.clean('konut'))
     OR toLower(apoc.text.clean(coalesce(p.name,''))) CONTAINS toLower(apoc.text.clean('konut'))
  )
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:HAS_INSURED_ITEM]->(ii:InsuredItem)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[r]->(d:Document)
WHERE type(r) IN ['DOCUMENTED_IN','HAS_ENDORSEMENT','HAS_CANCELLATION']
RETURN c.name AS customerName, c.fullName AS customerFullName, p.id AS policyId,
       p.policyNumber AS policyNumber, p.name AS policyName, p.type AS policyTypeProperty,
       pt.name AS policyTypeNode, p.year AS year,
       collect(DISTINCT ii.name)[0..10] AS insuredItems,
       collect(DISTINCT {docFile:d.fileName, docType:d.docType, docYear:d.year, docLink:d.doc_link, relType:type(r), source:r.source, endorsement_type: r.endorsement_type})[0..20] AS documents
LIMIT 10"}

WITH $embedding_vector AS queryVec
MATCH (content_node:Chunk)-[:PART_OF]->(d:Document)
WHERE id(d) = 11370
  AND content_node.embedding IS NOT NULL
WITH content_node, gds.similarity.cosine(content_node.embedding, queryVec) AS score
WHERE score >= 0.5
RETURN content_node.text AS text, content_node.page_number AS page, score
ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 10

Bu durumda, sigorta primi, teminat art\u0131\u015f oran\u0131n\u0131n yar\u0131s\u0131 kadar art\u0131r\u0131larak tespit edilir.\n\nEnflasyon nedeniyle azami teminat art\u0131\u015f oran\u0131: % 10\n\n## Ferdi Kaza:\n\n\u0130li\u015fik Ferdi Kaza Sigortas\u0131 Genel \u015eartlar\u0131 dahilinde, sigortal\u0131 konutta ya\u015fayan sigortal\u0131, e\u015fi ve\n\n---"}, {"chunkId": "6d912fa256bc8b7d8788cc83109eeb8708c5e210", "page": 6, "snippet": "- Sigorta bedeli, mevcut KDV'li sigorta de\u011ferinin alt\u0131nda ise bu kloz uygulanmayacak ve KDV \u00f6demesi yap\u0131lmayacakt\u0131r.\n- Bu kloz poli\u00e7ede bulunan ana teminat gruplar\u0131 i\u00e7in ge\u00e7erlidir.\n- Deprem, Sel seylap ve ayr\u0131ca afet ilan edilmi\u015f hasar tiplerinde, KDV yasal olarak mahsup edilebilir oldu\u011fu i\u00e7in KDV \u00f6denmeyecektir. Doga Sigorta A.\u015e.'nin ticaret sicil numaras\u0131 861987'dir. Sigorta ba\u015flang\u0131c\u0131na kadar ge\u00e7ecek s\u00fcre i\u00e7inde t\u00fcm sigorta \u015firketlerini ba\u011flay\u0131c\u0131 nitelikteki zorunlu tarife de\u011fi\u015fiklikleri fiyat \u00e7al\u0131\u015fmas\u0131 \u015fartlar\u0131na yans\u0131t\u0131lacakt\u0131r. Verilen fiyat \u00e7al\u0131\u015fmas\u0131nda belirtilen prim ve \u015fartlar 15 g\u00fcn i\u00e7in ge\u00e7erlidir ve kuver niteli\u011fi ta\u015f\u0131mamaktad\u0131r. \u0130\u015fbu fiyat \u00e7al\u0131\u015fmas\u0131, belirtilen genel \u015fartlar veya teklifte yer alan a\u00e7\u0131klamalar ve \u00f6zel \u015fartlar \u00e7er\u00e7evesinde d\u00fczenlenmi\u015f olup, ekli genel \u015fartlar ile birlikte edilir."}, {"chunkId": "582a728849cdb05acd8dcc22e5a1a19f5a781185", "page": 6, "snippet": "\u00d6nemli Uyar\u0131: Adres ve di\u011fer ileti\u015fim bilgileri sigortal\u0131n\u0131n beyan\u0131 do\u011frultusunda fiyat \u00e7al\u0131\u015fmas\u0131/ poli\u00e7eye yaz\u0131lm\u0131\u015f olup sigortac\u0131 t\u00fcm yaz\u0131\u015fma ve di\u011fer ileti\u015fiminde bu bilgileri kullanacakt\u0131r. Sigortac\u0131n\u0131n sorumlulu\u011fu; sigorta priminin pe\u015fin \u00f6denmesi kararla\u015ft\u0131r\u0131lm\u0131\u015f ise tamam\u0131n\u0131n, taksitle \u00f6denmesi kararla\u015ft\u0131r\u0131lm\u0131\u015f ise ilk taksitinin \u00f6denmesi ile ba\u015flar. Prim \u00f6deme plan\u0131nda belirtilen vadeler kesin olup prim taksitlerinden birinin \u00f6denmemesi temerr\u00fcd\u00fc do\u011furur.\n\nTemerr\u00fct halinde TTK'nin 1434.maddesi h\u00fck\u00fcmleri ge\u00e7erlidir. Sigortal\u0131 yada menfaat sahibi olan ki\u015filer Sigortac\u0131l\u0131k kanunu kapsam\u0131nda, 14.02.2011 tarih ve (2011/5) say\u0131l\u0131 genelgede belirtilen usuller\n\n---"}, {"chunkId": "4459258cc5bb2fec974b75fbc56d8ded6525d7c1", "page": 7, "snippet": "## Hukuksal Koruma Klozu :\n\nHukuksal Koruma Sigortas\u0131 Genel \u015eartlar\u0131 h\u00fck\u00fcmleri sakl\u0131 kalmak kayd\u0131yla sigortac\u0131, sigortal\u0131ya\n\n---\n\npoli\u00e7ede g\u00f6sterilen ta\u015f\u0131nmaz mal\u0131n tamam\u0131n\u0131n veya bir b\u00f6l\u00fcm\u00fcn\u00fcn poli\u00e7ede g\u00f6sterilmek kayd\u0131yla kiralayan\u0131, kirac\u0131s\u0131 veya ayn\u0131 hak sahibi s\u0131fatlar\u0131ndan biri veya hepsine ba\u011fl\u0131 olarak do\u011fabilecek uyu\u015fmazl\u0131klar i\u00e7in y\u0131ll\u0131k toplamda poli\u00e7ede yaz\u0131l\u0131 limitlere kadar koruma sa\u011flar. Teminat, davada h\u00fckmedilen tazminat y\u00fck\u00fcml\u00fcl\u00fcklerini kapsamamakta olup, sadece vekalet, dan\u0131\u015fmanl\u0131k \u00fccretleri, teminat ak\u00e7esi, icra masraf\u0131, temyiz, karar d\u00fczeltme, ihtarname \u00e7ekimi, dilek\u00e7e yaz\u0131m\u0131 ve cevap yaz\u0131mlar\u0131 vb. dava masraflar\u0131 ile s\u0131n\u0131rl\u0131d\u0131r.\n\n## Uyar\u0131:\n\n-Rizikonun ger\u00e7ekle\u015fmesi durumunda, sigortal\u0131n\u0131n serbest\u00e7e eksper tayin edebilme hakk\u0131 vard\u0131r. Sigorta hasar eksperlerinin isim ve adres bilgileri T\u00fcrkiye Odalar ve Borsalar Birli\u011fi'nin internet sitesinden (http://www.tobb.org.tr) temin edilebilir.\n\n-Doga Sigorta A.\u015e. Aksi halde, poli\u00e7e teslim edilmi\u015f olsa dahi sorumluluk ba\u015flamaz \u0130lk taksidi veya tamam\u0131 bir defada \u00f6denmesi gereken prim, zaman\u0131nda \u00f6denmemi\u015fse, sigortac\u0131, \u00f6deme yap\u0131lmad\u0131\u011f\u0131 s\u00fcrece, s\u00f6zle\u015fmeden \u00fc\u00e7 ay i\u00e7inde cayabilir. Bu s\u00fcre, vadeden ba\u015flar. Prim alaca\u011f\u0131n\u0131n, muacceliyet g\u00fcn\u00fcnden itibaren \u00fc\u00e7 ay i\u00e7inde dava veya takip yoluyla istenmemi\u015f olmas\u0131 h\u00e2linde, s\u00f6zle\u015fmeden cay\u0131lm\u0131\u015f olunur. \u0130zleyen primlerden herhangi biri zaman\u0131nda \u00f6denmez ise, sigortac\u0131 sigorta ettirene, noter arac\u0131l\u0131\u011f\u0131 veya iadeli taahh\u00fctl\u00fc mektupla on g\u00fcnl\u00fck s\u00fcre vererek borcunu yerine getirmesini, aksi h\u00e2lde, s\u00fcre sonunda, s\u00f6zle\u015fmenin feshedilmi\u015f say\u0131laca\u011f\u0131n\u0131 ihtar eder. Bu s\u00fcrenin bitiminde bor\u00e7 \u00f6denmemi\u015f ise sigorta s\u00f6zle\u015fmesi feshedilmi\u015f olur."}, {"chunkId": "deb867e18e01cd2fd84d0908ad0bc7c395784e48", "page": 10, "snippet": "1. Doga Sigorta A.\u015e.'nin ticaret sicil numaras\u0131 861987'dir. Sigorta ba\u015flang\u0131c\u0131na kadar ge\u00e7ecek s\u00fcre i\u00e7inde t\u00fcm sigorta \u015firketlerini ba\u011flay\u0131c\u0131 nitelikteki zorunlu tarife de\u011fi\u015fiklikleri fiyat \u00e7al\u0131\u015fmas\u0131 \u015fartlar\u0131na yans\u0131t\u0131lacakt\u0131r. Verilen fiyat \u00e7al\u0131\u015fmas\u0131nda belirtilen prim ve \u015fartlar 15 g\u00fcn i\u00e7in ge\u00e7erlidir ve kuver niteli\u011fi ta\u015f\u0131mamaktad\u0131r. \u0130\u015fbu fiyat \u00e7al\u0131\u015fmas\u0131, belirtilen genel \u015fartlar veya teklifte yer alan a\u00e7\u0131klamalar ve \u00f6zel \u015fartlar \u00e7er\u00e7evesinde d\u00fczenlenmi\u015f olup, ekli genel \u015fartlar ile birlikte edilir."}, {"chunkId": "582a728849cdb05acd8dcc22e5a1a19f5a781185", "page": 6, "snippet": "\u00d6nemli Uyar\u0131: Adres ve di\u011fer ileti\u015fim bilgileri sigortal\u0131n\u0131n beyan\u0131 do\u011frultusunda fiyat \u00e7al\u0131\u015fmas\u0131/ poli\u00e7eye yaz\u0131lm\u0131\u015f olup sigortac\u0131 t\u00fcm yaz\u0131\u015fma ve di\u011fer ileti\u015fiminde bu bilgileri kullanacakt\u0131r. Sigortal\u0131 yada menfaat sahibi olan ki\u015filer Sigortac\u0131l\u0131k kanunu kapsam\u0131nda, 14.02.2011 tarih ve (2011/5) say\u0131l\u0131 genelgede belirtilen usuller\n\n---"}, {"chunkId": "4459258cc5bb2fec974b75fbc56d8ded6525d7c1", "page": 7, "snippet": "## Hukuksal Koruma Klozu :\n\nHukuksal Koruma Sigortas\u0131 Genel \u015eartlar\u0131 h\u00fck\u00fcmleri sakl\u0131 kalmak kayd\u0131yla sigortac\u0131, sigortal\u0131ya\n\n---\n\npoli\u00e7ede g\u00f6sterilen ta\u015f\u0131nmaz mal\u0131n tamam\u0131n\u0131n veya bir b\u00f6l\u00fcm\u00fcn\u00fcn poli\u00e7ede g\u00f6sterilmek kayd\u0131yla kiralayan\u0131, kirac\u0131s\u0131 veya ayn\u0131 hak sahibi s\u0131fatlar\u0131ndan biri veya hepsine ba\u011fl\u0131 olarak do\u011fabilecek uyu\u015fmazl\u0131klar i\u00e7in y\u0131ll\u0131k toplamda poli\u00e7ede yaz\u0131l\u0131 limitlere kadar koruma sa\u011flar. Teminat, davada h\u00fckmedilen tazminat y\u00fck\u00fcml\u00fcl\u00fcklerini kapsamamakta olup, sadece vekalet, dan\u0131\u015fmanl\u0131k \u00fccretleri, teminat ak\u00e7esi, icra masraf\u0131, temyiz, karar d\u00fczeltme, ihtarname \u00e7ekimi, dilek\u00e7e yaz\u0131m\u0131 ve cevap yaz\u0131mlar\u0131 vb. dava masraflar\u0131 ile s\u0131n\u0131rl\u0131d\u0131r.\n\n## Uyar\u0131:\n\n-Rizikonun ger\u00e7ekle\u015fmesi durumunda, sigortal\u0131n\u0131n serbest\u00e7e eksper tayin edebilme hakk\u0131 vard\u0131r. Aksi halde, poli\u00e7e teslim edilmi\u015f olsa dahi sorumluluk ba\u015flamaz \u0130lk taksidi veya tamam\u0131 bir defada \u00f6denmesi gereken prim, zaman\u0131nda \u00f6denmemi\u015fse, sigortac\u0131, \u00f6deme yap\u0131lmad\u0131\u011f\u0131 s\u00fcrece, s\u00f6zle\u015fmeden \u00fc\u00e7 ay i\u00e7inde cayabilir. Bu s\u00fcre, vadeden ba\u015flar. Prim alaca\u011f\u0131n\u0131n, muacceliyet g\u00fcn\u00fcnden itibaren \u00fc\u00e7 ay i\u00e7inde dava veya takip yoluyla istenmemi\u015f olmas\u0131 h\u00e2linde, s\u00f6zle\u015fmeden cay\u0131lm\u0131\u015f olunur. \u0130zleyen primlerden herhangi biri zaman\u0131nda \u00f6denmez ise, sigortac\u0131 sigorta ettirene, noter arac\u0131l\u0131\u011f\u0131 veya iadeli taahh\u00fctl\u00fc mektupla on g\u00fcnl\u00fck s\u00fcre vererek borcunu yerine getirmesini, aksi h\u00e2lde, s\u00fcre sonunda, s\u00f6zle\u015fmenin feshedilmi\u015f say\u0131laca\u011f\u0131n\u0131 ihtar eder. Bu s\u00fcrenin bitiminde bor\u00e7 \u00f6denmemi\u015f ise sigorta s\u00f6zle\u015fmesi feshedilmi\u015f olur."}, {"chunkId": "deb867e18e01cd2fd84d0908ad0bc7c395784e48", "page": 10, "snippet": "1. Primin \u00f6denmemesi durumunda, aksi kararla\u015ft\u0131r\u0131lmad\u0131k\u00e7a, sigortac\u0131n\u0131n sorumlulu\u011fu ba\u015flamaz.\n3. \u0130leride do\u011fabilecek birtak\u0131m ihtilaflar\u0131 \u00f6nlemek i\u00e7in, prim \u00f6demelerinizde (pe\u015fin veya taksitle) \u00f6deme belgesi almay\u0131 unutmay\u0131n\u0131z. \u00d6deme Belgelerinizin Doga Sigorta A.\u015e orijinal makbuzu olmas\u0131na dikkat ediniz.\n4. S\u00f6zle\u015fmenin kurulmas\u0131 s\u0131ras\u0131nda, sigorta s\u00fcresince ve rizikonun ger\u00e7ekle\u015fmesi durumunda sigortac\u0131ya eksik veya yanl\u0131\u015f bilgi vermekten ka\u00e7\u0131n\u0131n\u0131z.
